faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to popular questions about UniPark system

installTime.question: How quickly can the system be installed?
installTime.answer: Installation and setup takes 1 to 3 days depending on parking size. We provide full technical support at all stages of implementation.

accuracy.question: What is the license plate recognition accuracy?
accuracy.answer: Our system provides up to 98% recognition accuracy even in difficult weather conditions. Modern machine learning algorithms are used.

integration.question: Can it integrate with existing systems?
integration.answer: Yes, UniPark provides API for integration with your accounting systems, CRM, 1C and other platforms. Ready integrations with popular services are also available.

offline.question: What happens when the internet goes down?
offline.answer: The system has a local mode and continues to function without internet connection. All data is synchronized after connection is restored.

support.question: What support is provided?
support.answer: We offer technical support on all plans. Business plan and above includes priority 24/7 support with guaranteed response time.

freeTrial.question: Can I try the system for free?
freeTrial.answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial for Starter and Business plans. No credit card required and no obligations.

faq.subtitle: Answers to questions about pricing and payment

coefficient.question: How is the regional coefficient calculated?
coefficient.answer: Final price = base tariff × region coefficient × flow coefficient. For example, for a parking lot in central Tashkent with high traffic: base price × 1.0 × 1.15.

additionalGate.question: How much does an additional gate cost?
additionalGate.answer: Each additional gate costs +300,000 UZS/month. Additional parking facilities are billed separately.

yearlyDiscount.question: What discounts are available for annual payment?
yearlyDiscount.answer: 12-month payment gets −10% discount, 24-month payment gets −20% discount. Individual terms are negotiated for Mega Park.

government.question: Are there special terms for government organizations?
government.answer: Yes, Enterprise Custom plan is available for government and large clients: SaaS + On-premise hybrid, individual functionality, UZS/USD settlements, integration with government information systems, separate SLA and contract.

installation.question: What does the installation service include?
installation.answer: One-time installation service: server and network setup, camera and barrier connection, tariff and role configuration, administrator and operator training, manual and video tutorials.

roi.question: How long does it take for the system to pay for itself?
roi.answer: Example: Large Park — one-time 8,000,000 UZS + 12-month SaaS ≈ 19,200,000 UZS. Total 1-year cost ≈ 27.2M UZS. In practice, with payment discipline and transparent control, it pays for itself in 6-9 months.
